```{r}
#| label: worldpop-density-note
#| results: asis
if (exists("density") && nrow(density) > 0) {
  city_dens <- density %>% filter(Location == city, !is.na(Density)) %>% slice(1) %>% pull(Density)
  if (length(city_dens) > 0 && !is.na(city_dens[1])) {
    print_text(glue("{paste_bold(city)} has a population density of {paste_bold(scales::comma(round(city_dens[1])))} people per km²"))
  }
}
```
